settings.heading: We're here to help
settings.text: A question about a scent, an order or anything else — write to us and we'll reply within one business day.

settings.question: Where is my order?
settings.answer: You'll receive a tracking link by email as soon as your order ships — usually within 1–2 business days.

settings.question: Can I return a fragrance?
settings.answer: Unopened items can be returned within 30 days of delivery. Write to us and we'll arrange it.
